submitted.rationale: All EQE values under 2.1 eV illumination are tiny, because the photon energy is below or near the Bi–Sb oxide band gaps. The measured EQE rose with Sb fraction: 0.00009% at x=0.080, 0.00004% at 0.272, 0.00017% at 0.545 and 0.00037% at 0.699 (the highest). The neighbouring point at x=0.718 gave -0.00014%, which looks like noise. That suggests the maximum is near x≈0.70.
